name: secendthink
description: Turn a rough request into a clear, thorough ultra prompt, then carry it out using your selected model.

interface.shortDescription: Improve your request, then carry it out.
interface.longDescription: Use secendthink or its st shortcut to turn your request into a polished prompt with a clear goal, relevant context, constraints, deliverables, and success criteria, then immediately complete the task. Uses the model already selected in your task, with no copy-paste step. Ask for only the prompt when you want to reuse it elsewhere.
defaultPrompt: Use $secendthink to improve my next request into an ultra prompt, then carry it out.
Use $st to improve and carry out this request: plan my portfolio website.
